open_questions.gap: Media budget amount, scope, and relationship to RFP €140k figure undefined; MARIA (CFO) states her approved budget is production+fees only (120–125k), while media spend is controlled by management with separate media agency.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Total budget scope affects deliverable scale and channel mix strategy; unclear whether €140k in RFP is production-only or inclusive of media.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Να επιβεβαιώσουμε: το €140.000 του RFP περιλαμβάνει το media spend; και ποιο είναι το media budget range;

open_questions.gap: Launch timing conditionally mid-March but board is discussing seasonal factors and may shift; final confirmation expected within one month from meeting date.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Production timeline, media booking schedule, and retail coordination depend on confirmed launch window.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Πότε θα έχετε τελική απόφαση από το board για το launch window; τι είναι η expected σεζόν που συζητείται;

open_questions.gap: Athleisure lifestyle positioning is NIKOS's revised thinking but has not yet been locked with the board; RFP positioning emphasized technical superiority and athletic specs, which NIKOS now believes is incorrect strategy.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Core positioning determines creative direction, messaging strategy, competitor framing, and media targeting.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Μπορούμε να σχεδιάσουμε βάσει του athleisure lifestyle story, ή πρέπει πρώτα να επιβεβαιώσετε με το board;

open_questions.gap: KPIs and success metrics are undefined. NIKOS acknowledges this gap and suggests building them in the proposal, but no targets stated for sales, awareness, trial rate, retail sell-in velocity, or other measures.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Without defined KPIs, cannot align creative and media strategy with business outcomes or measure campaign effectiveness.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Ποιες είναι οι κύριες μετρήσεις επιτυχίας; Υπάρχουν targets σε brand awareness, trial conversion, ή retail velocity;

open_questions.gap: Hero video and social content specs not finalized: formats, durations, quantities, and production approach undefined. NIKOS deferred decisions to agency guidance.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Detailed format specifications drive production planning, cost estimation, platform strategy, and media buying.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Για το hero video και τα social assets: ποιες είναι οι preferred διάρκειες, formats, και ποσότητα content;

open_questions.gap: RFP audience definition (women 30–45) contradicts NIKOS's stated actual market (unisex, 25–55). NIKOS attributes RFP definition to outdated research from previous product line. Formal confirmation needed.
open_questions.why_it_matters: Target audience definition drives creative conception, platform selection, media buying strategy, and influencer/talent choices.
open_questions.suggested_question_for_client: Να επιβεβαιώσουμε: η σωστή target audience είναι 25–55, unisex, όχι γυναίκες 30–45 όπως λέει το RFP;
